comp.description: SiC MOSFET 1700 V 40 mOhm, TO-247-4L with driver source, VGS -8/+22 V abs, -4/+18 V op; no qualification stated (Sichain p14: consult for high reliability). Mount on PAD_AL2O3 (0.635 mm Al2O3, pcs_spec R_cs). ACCEPTANCE per switch: R_DS(on) of the six devices of one switch within +/-5 % of their mean at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C (incoming measurement or the maker's bin; the data sheet allows 40 typ / 52 max mOhm) - bounds the conduction share at k <= 1.086; V_GS(th) within +/-0.25 V (V_DS = V_GS, I_D 12 mA, 25 C; data-sheet spread 2.5-4.0 V) for the switching share; one lot per switch; ABSOLUTE: R_DS(on) <= 40.0 mOhm for each device at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C - the same incoming measurement as the +/-5 % matching rule (no extra test, no extra hardware); data sheet 40 typ / 52 max: parts between 40.0 and 52 mOhm are not scrapped - a module with any of them is grade B and runs grade B's tier table (pcs_spec desat rds_acceptance grade_tier_tables, by inlet, V_dc, PF and start state; at 45 C inlet continuous 196.8 A, 2 min = 200 ms 207.5 A; at 60 C 179.8 / 192.6 A, 110 % not held), a parameter set bound to the module serial

ACCEPTANCE per switch: R_DS(on) of the six devices of one switch within +/-5 % of their mean at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C (incoming measurement or the maker's bin; the data sheet allows 40 typ / 52 max mOhm) - bounds the conduction share at k <= 1.086; V_GS(th) within +/-0.25 V (V_DS = V_GS, I_D 12 mA, 25 C; data-sheet spread 2.5-4.0 V) for the switching share; one lot per switch; ABSOLUTE: R_DS(on) <= 40.0 mOhm for each device at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C - the same incoming measurement as the +/-5 % matching rule (no extra test, no extra hardware); data sheet 40 typ / 52 max: parts between 40.0 and 52 mOhm are not scrapped - a module with any of them is grade B and runs grade B's tier table (pcs_spec desat rds_acceptance grade_tier_tables, by inlet, V_dc, PF and start state; at 45 C inlet continuous 196.8 A, 2 min = 200 ms 207.5 A; at 60 C 179.8 / 192.6 A, 110 % not held), a parameter set bound to the module serial

comp.description: SiC MOSFET 1700 V 40 mOhm, TO-247-4L with driver source, VGS -8/+22 V abs, -4/+18 V op; no qualification stated (Sichain p14: consult for high reliability). Mount on PAD_AL2O3 (0.635 mm Al2O3, pcs_spec R_cs). ACCEPTANCE per switch: R_DS(on) of the six devices of one switch within +/-5 % of their mean at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C (incoming measurement or the maker's bin; the data sheet allows 40 typ / 52 max mOhm) - bounds the conduction share at k <= 1.086; V_GS(th) within +/-0.25 V (V_DS = V_GS, I_D 12 mA, 25 C; data-sheet spread 2.5-4.0 V) for the switching share; one lot per switch; ABSOLUTE: R_DS(on) <= 40.0 mOhm for each device at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C - the same incoming measurement as the +/-5 % matching rule (no extra test, no extra hardware); data sheet 40 typ / 52 max: parts between 40.0 and 52 mOhm are not scrapped - a module with any of them is grade B and runs grade B's tier table (pcs_spec desat rds_acceptance grade_tier_tables, by inlet, V_dc, PF and start state; at 45 C inlet continuous 196.8 A, 2 min = 200 ms 207.5 A; at 60 C 179.8 / 192.6 A, 110 % not held), a parameter set bound to the module serial

RFQ type-B residual-current sensor (fluxgate) around L1-L3 and N - INTERFACE CONTRACT (pcs_spec residual_current_contract, review R2-13; every figure ASSUMED until the part is chosen): type B: AC to >= 2 kHz, pulsating DC and smooth DC residual current (fluxgate), one sensor around every live conductor; trips in firmware from the analog output (the sensor has no trip relay): continuous residual current >= 1250 mA (10 mA per kVA above 30 kVA, 125 kVA) within 0.3 s; sudden changes 30 mA within 0.30 s / 60 mA within 0.15 s / 150 mA within 0.04 s; DC and AC (rms) alike; range +/-2.0 A, +/-(3 % of reading + 3 mA), DC to 1 kHz; resolution <= 6 mA DC / 30 mA AC; OUT analog voltage, 2.50 V +/-1 % at zero residual current, 1.00 V/A +/-3 % (+/-2.0 A in 0.50-4.50 V), DC to >= 2 kHz (-3 dB), >= 0.25 mA into the control board's 10.0k / 13.0k divider, noise <= 3 mA rms equivalent; diagnostic on OUT, no separate pin: an internal fault (fluxgate oscillator stopped, supply out of range, failed self-check) drives OUT to <= 0.25 V or >= 4.75 V within <= 100 ms - outside the 0.50-4.50 V signal band; firmware: sensor fault -> no connection / controlled stop; TEST TEST, 3.3 V CMOS active high, >= 10 kOhm (RCM_TST from GPIO21 through PCS_X, 100k pull-down on the power board): injects 50 mA DC +/-20 % through the test winding, OUT steps by 50 mV +/-20 % within <= 50 ms; used by the start-up self-test and before every connection; supply 5 V +/-5 % from the power board's +5V, <= 50 mA including start-up (the +5V budget's allocation); aperture L1-L3 + N: 4 bars 16 x 4.5 mm on edge with 1 mm sleeves (30.5 x 18 mm, the AC CM choke's fit); the bars are LIVE (V_dc/2 + 375 V x 1.2 against DC-, <= 1050 V DC + the OVC III impulse): bar to sensor electronics through the 1.5 kV rms bar sleeves plus the sensor's own functional insulation, referenced to DC- like the board

libpart.description: RFQ type-B residual-current sensor (fluxgate) around L1-L3 and N - INTERFACE CONTRACT (pcs_spec residual_current_contract, review R2-13; every figure ASSUMED until the part is chosen): type B: AC to >= 2 kHz, pulsating DC and smooth DC residual current (fluxgate), one sensor around every live conductor; trips in firmware from the analog output (the sensor has no trip relay): continuous residual current >= 1250 mA (10 mA per kVA above 30 kVA, 125 kVA) within 0.3 s; sudden changes 30 mA within 0.30 s / 60 mA within 0.15 s / 150 mA within 0.04 s; DC and AC (rms) alike; range +/-2.0 A, +/-(3 % of reading + 3 mA), DC to 1 kHz; resolution <= 6 mA DC / 30 mA AC; OUT analog voltage, 2.50 V +/-1 % at zero residual current, 1.00 V/A +/-3 % (+/-2.0 A in 0.50-4.50 V), DC to >= 2 kHz (-3 dB), >= 0.25 mA into the control board's 10.0k / 13.0k divider, noise <= 3 mA rms equivalent; diagnostic on OUT, no separate pin: an internal fault (fluxgate oscillator stopped, supply out of range, failed self-check) drives OUT to <= 0.25 V or >= 4.75 V within <= 100 ms - outside the 0.50-4.50 V signal band; firmware: sensor fault -> no connection / controlled stop; TEST TEST, 3.3 V CMOS active high, >= 10 kOhm (RCM_TST from GPIO21 through PCS_X, 100k pull-down on the power board): injects 50 mA DC +/-20 % through the test winding, OUT steps by 50 mV +/-20 % within <= 50 ms; used by the start-up self-test and before every connection; supply 5 V +/-5 % from the power board's +5V, <= 50 mA including start-up (the +5V budget's allocation); aperture L1-L3 + N: 4 bars 16 x 4.5 mm on edge with 1 mm sleeves (30.5 x 18 mm, the AC CM choke's fit); the bars are LIVE (V_dc/2 + 375 V x 1.2 against DC-, <= 1050 V DC + the OVC III impulse): bar to sensor electronics through the 1.5 kV rms bar sleeves plus the sensor's own functional insulation, referenced to DC- like the board

libpart.description: SiC MOSFET 1700 V 40 mOhm, TO-247-4L with driver source, VGS -8/+22 V abs, -4/+18 V op; no qualification stated (Sichain p14: consult for high reliability). Mount on PAD_AL2O3 (0.635 mm Al2O3, pcs_spec R_cs). ACCEPTANCE per switch: R_DS(on) of the six devices of one switch within +/-5 % of their mean at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C (incoming measurement or the maker's bin; the data sheet allows 40 typ / 52 max mOhm) - bounds the conduction share at k <= 1.086; V_GS(th) within +/-0.25 V (V_DS = V_GS, I_D 12 mA, 25 C; data-sheet spread 2.5-4.0 V) for the switching share; one lot per switch; ABSOLUTE: R_DS(on) <= 40.0 mOhm for each device at V_GS 18 V, I_D 38 A pulsed (< 200 us), T_J 25 C - the same incoming measurement as the +/-5 % matching rule (no extra test, no extra hardware); data sheet 40 typ / 52 max: parts between 40.0 and 52 mOhm are not scrapped - a module with any of them is grade B and runs grade B's tier table (pcs_spec desat rds_acceptance grade_tier_tables, by inlet, V_dc, PF and start state; at 45 C inlet continuous 196.8 A, 2 min = 200 ms 207.5 A; at 60 C 179.8 / 192.6 A, 110 % not held), a parameter set bound to the module serial
